name: CONUS
long_description:
CONUS is the AI knowledge layer for surgery, connecting medical device manufacturers with hospitals. We bring product information, hospital protocols and medical research together, helping doctors and sales reps find answers in seconds.

We already work with leading manufacturers including Johnson & Johnson, Stryker and Zimmer Biomet. Our long-term ambition is to let hospitals select and order implants from all manufacturers on one platform: Amazon for implants, embedded in the surgical workflow.
one_liner: The AI knowledge layer for medical devices
